people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

translations.web: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.
translations.bsb: The king extended the gold scepter toward Esther, and she arose and stood before the king.
